​​​​​​​Our core values​​​​​​​
Curiosity, Kindness, Responsibility
Welcome to Tackley CE Primary School
“Living, Loving and Learning Together”
Tackley CE Primary School is at the centre of the village. We serve our community by providing a creative and exciting curriculum within the context of Christian belief and practice. Our core Christian values are: curiosity, kindness and responsibility. Through the Parable of the Lost Sheep, we help our children understand we come together as one to ensure no child is left behind and to enable them to live life in all its fullness.

pageCache.pageTitle: Tackley CE Primary School - Woodstock Partnership
pageCache.text:
Woodstock Partnership
We have strong links with other local schools including our secondary school in the Woodstock Partnership. This partnership allows us to meet throughout the year to take part in Partnership sports competitions and work collaboratively with other primary schools in the Partnership taking part in moderation and staff training together.
The transition of children to KS3 is important and we encourage children to seize opportunities to take part in events held at our partner secondary school. We are so fortunate to participate in The Resilience Project led by Miss Malloch. This helps our Year 6 pupils become familiar with the school before they transfer in September of each year.

pageCache.pageTitle: Tackley CE Primary School - Wraparound care
pageCache.text:
Wraparound care
Breakfast Club
Tackley School Breakfast Club runs from 7:30am until 8:30am from Monday to Thursday and also has the option of an 8:00am start.
The club currently runs from the hall and children have a choice of cereal or toast for breakfast.
Bookings can be made via ParentPay a week in advance with a cut off point of midnight on a Sunday.
After School Club
Tackley School After School Club runs from 3:00pm until 5:00pm from Monday to Thursday and has the use of the playground and outdoor areas of the school.
If children are taking part in after school sports clubs which run 3:00pm to 4:00pm, they can be booked into the After School Club Half Session which runs 4:00pm until 5:00pm.
The club currently runs from the hall where your children can enjoy a wide range of activities on offer. The room is set up in two parts; one for physical activity using the gym equipment and apparatus and the other for practical hands on activities – these might be arts and crafts, painting, drawing or board and card games.
Tackley After School Club offer healthy snacks and drinks. Please see the menu for more detail.
Our staff at the After School Club are there to ensure that your children are provided with activities that they are guaranteed to enjoy. Time to is also made for children to wind down after a busy school day, and we place great importance on children of all ages playing together and socialising with each other.
For more details about After School Club, how to book and pay for sessions please contact the School Office.

pageCache.text:
SEND and Inclusion
At Tackley CE Primary School, we are committed to providing an environment where everyone is important and valued and can achieve their absolute best. We know that all of the children in our school have unique talents, but that, at some point, many children may find aspects of school – be they academic, social, emotional or behavioural – challenging. All staff at Tackley share a commitment to supporting any child with an additional or special need, be this a short-term problem related to a very small part of the curriculum or school life, or more complex needs.
We strive to provide the support each pupil needs in order for them to become a motivated and successful learner. This support takes different forms for each child, but some of our strategies include:
The documents in this section of the website provide more detail about our approach to supporting pupils with special educational needs. If you would like to find out more, please contact Mrs Sonya Barnett, (SENCo) via the email senco@tackley.oxon.sch.uk or Mrs Karen Ward, Headteacher. You can also find out more about some of the support which Oxfordshire County Council (OCC) offers more generally by looking at their Local Offer – link available below.

Curriculum
Our Curriculum Intent
At Tackley Primary School we provide an engaging, inspiring and responsive curriculum which provides children with the knowledge, skills and understanding they need to prepare themselves for life beyond the classroom.
We place importance on experiences and opportunities to broaden the children’s understanding of the wider curriculum and have a rich variety of educational visits and experiences planned into our whole school curriculum.
Our 3 core curriculum drivers are centred around curiosity, creativity and independence.

pageCache.pageTitle: Tackley CE Primary School - Collective Worship
pageCache.text:
Collective Worship
Tackley CE Primary school is an inclusive community that builds understanding, respect and empathy in young people.
Pupils, staff and parents of all faiths, or none, are welcome. Our school is a community that celebrates religious, cultural and ethnic diversity and encourages dialogue and understanding. We believe that we can all learn from each other and that collective worship is an educational entitlement for all.
Our worship is invitational, and we create the opportunity to explore the place of faith in each of our lives, and in the communities in which we live. This worship can occur at various times of day and with a mixture of grouping of pupils. In regular acts of worship our school community has the opportunity of offering thanksgiving and praise to God through a range of liturgical patterns
Our Collective Worship policy can be found on our policies page
